priorityList: Cast Primal Wrath with 5 Combo Points if Rip is not active, or is within its Pandemic timer, or if the Rip snapshot can be strengthened with Tiger's Fury.
Cast Ferocious Bite with 5 Combo Points, or with an Apex Predator's Craving proc.
Cast Tiger's Fury on cooldown, aiming to be 70 or more Energy below your cap when used.
Cast Berserk on cooldown, synced with Tiger's Fury.
Cast Convoke the Spirits with Tiger's Fury active, during Berserk, before Tiger's Fury expires, with as few Combo Points as possible.
Cast Swipe to generate Combo Points.
Avoid wasting Tiger's Fury through misuse or natural over-capping
